summary: Select hybrid MoE precision by request phase and prefetch CSF scales only for consumers that need expansion
compatibility: Hybrid prefill remains disabled by default. Enable it with B12X_W4A16_A4_PREFILL=1 and a FlashInfer build exposing semantic A4 selection and uses_expanded_nvfp4_scales. B12X_W4A16_A4_PREFILL_MIN_TOKENS is removed; VLLM_B12X_ACTIVATION_MODE_A16_M continues to apply outside hybrid MoE.
details: Prefill rows use calibrated A4 independently of row count; decode and speculative verification rows retain A16.
CSF prefetch queries the following layer's prepared kernel for each semantic row range, including uncalibrated A16 fallback and exact decode variants.
Pending side-stream expansion events are still waited on before shared scratch reuse. CUDA graph capture and replay retain A16.
